---
title: atlas create
description: Scaffold a new Atlas project.
icon: FolderPlus
---

## Usage

```bash
atlas create [options]
```

## Description

Scaffolds a new project with `atlas.yaml`, Dockerfile, CI workflow, and `.gitignore`. Interactive prompts guide you through project name, organization, services, and infrastructure choices.

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--name` | Project name |
| `--yes, -y` | Non-interactive mode (uses defaults) |

## Generated files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `atlas.yaml` | Project configuration |
| `Dockerfile` | Multi-stage build for the primary service |
| `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` | CI/CD workflow for GitHub Actions |
| `.gitignore` | Standard ignores for the detected stack |

## Examples

```bash
atlas create                # Interactive scaffolding
atlas create --name myapp   # Skip name prompt
```
